name: Keeper's Scroll: Aman'thul is a non-equippable consumable, not a main-hand weapon (#10306)
contract: Keeper's Scroll: Aman'thul (246199) is a consumable scroll (Class 0, Subclass 1) sold on the Ethereal Bazaar Consumables vendor list (900012) alongside sibling Keeper's Scrolls (246194, 97388, 696661-696665), all of which have InventoryType 0 and zero weapon damage/delay.
Both item_template and Item.dbc had InventoryType 21 (Main Hand) plus 0.8-0.8 damage and 2000 ms delay, causing it to display as a Main-Hand weapon.

Querying item 246199 (CMSG_ITEM_QUERY_SINGLE, opcode 86) must return SMSG_ITEM_QUERY_SINGLE_RESPONSE (opcode 88) with InventoryType 0 (u32 index 6 after the 4 name strings), zero Damage[0].DamageMin/DamageMax (float indices 24/25 with StatsCount 0), and Delay 0 (u32 index 37), and must stream SMSG_PATCH_ITEM (opcode 2354) for row 246199 with ClassID 0, SubclassID 1, DisplayInfoID 67491, and InventoryType 0.
